#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
fiber_evidence="/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/selected-fiber-seeding.CIBz1x"
for fiber_round in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do
    if (( fiber_round % 2 )); then
        fiber_order="baseline candidate"
    else
        fiber_order="candidate baseline"
    fi
    for fiber_fixture in bezier_region rational_bezier; do
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$fiber_evidence/repeat-$fiber_fixture-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-$fiber_fixture" \
                > "$fiber_evidence/repeat-$fiber_fixture-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
            printf '%s %s %s passed\n' "$fiber_fixture" "$fiber_round" "$fiber_variant"
        done
    done
done
node "$fiber_evidence/collect-results.mjs" "$fiber_evidence" repeat 7 > "$fiber_evidence/repeat-results.json"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
fiber_evidence="/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/selected-fiber-seeding.CIBz1x"
for fiber_round in 1 2 3; do
    if (( fiber_round % 2 )); then
        fiber_order="baseline candidate"
    else
        fiber_order="candidate baseline"
    fi
    for fiber_case in selected chord radial contacts; do
        case "$fiber_case" in
            contacts) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::selected_parallel_normal_circle_retains_general_rational_contacts_in_one_fiber" ;;
            selected) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::selected_fiber_genuinely_analytic_contacts_complete_region_booleans" ;;
            chord) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::recursive_selected_radial_diameter_chord_intersects_a_rational_quadratic_strict" ;;
            radial) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::recursively_pair_radial_circle_intersects_a_genuine_analytic_parallel" ;;
        esac
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_case-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-test" "$fiber_test" \
                --exact --include-ignored --test-threads=1 \
                > "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_case-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
            printf '%s %s %s passed\n' "$fiber_case" "$fiber_round" "$fiber_variant"
        done
    done
    for fiber_bench in bezier_region rational_bezier; do
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_bench-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-$fiber_bench" \
                > "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_bench-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
    for fiber_fixture in rectangles circles capsules; do
        unset HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE
        if [[ "$fiber_fixture" != rectangles ]]; then
            export HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE="$fiber_fixture"
        fi
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_ITERATIONS=1000 \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-curve_region_boolean_batch" \
                > "$fiber_evidence/paired-$fiber_fixture-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
done

reproduction.heap_driver:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
fiber_evidence="/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/selected-fiber-seeding.CIBz1x"
fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::selected_parallel_normal_circle_retains_general_rational_contacts_in_one_fiber"
for fiber_variant in baseline candidate; do
    /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
        -o "$fiber_evidence/heap-contacts-$fiber_variant.time" \
        taskset -c 3 /usr/bin/heaptrack --raw --record-only \
        -o "$fiber_evidence/heap-contacts-$fiber_variant" \
        "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-test" "$fiber_test" \
        --exact --include-ignored --test-threads=1 \
        > "$fiber_evidence/heap-contacts-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
    zstd --test "$fiber_evidence/heap-contacts-$fiber_variant.raw.zst"
    /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
        -o "$fiber_evidence/heap-contacts-$fiber_variant-accounting.time" \
        bash -o pipefail -c 'zstd -dc "$1" | "$2"' -- \
        "$fiber_evidence/heap-contacts-$fiber_variant.raw.zst" \
        "$fiber_evidence/raw-allocation-traces" \
        > "$fiber_evidence/heap-contacts-$fiber_variant-accounting.json"
    printf '%s passed\n' "$fiber_variant"
done
